summary: Both backend TTS APIs and Suara pembayaran UI enhancements verified. 10/10 pytest cases pass on 390x844 mobile viewport. Backend POST /api/tts/generate (tts-1-hd, speed 0.94) returns valid mp3 for putri/lilis/parjo/bagas with 4 DISTINCT cache keys (new voice map lilis=coral, bagas=ash). Lilis Sundanese greeting 'Sampurasun, abdi Teh Lilis. Kumaha damang?' returns playable audio/mpeg. Idempotent caching, 404 unknown key, 400 empty/whitespace text all correct. Frontend: 4 voice cards render with photo avatars from /assets/characters/{id}.png (all 4 images matched in DOM); Kak Putri default; tapping voice-lilis moves the checkmark; each per-character test-voice-{id} button is pressable without crash and invokes previewVoice/TTS greeting; volume segments vol-Pelan/vol-Sedang/vol-Keras selectable and highlight correctly; pick/record intro & outro buttons render and are interactive; Preview Suara and Test pembayaran work; test-payment inserts Rp 42.500 transaction visible in Riwayat. No red-screen errors, no page-level exceptions.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend VOICE_MAP correctly updated: lilis->coral, parjo->onyx, bagas->ash, putri->nova; distinct sha256 cache keys confirmed (also depend on TTS_MODEL/TTS_SPEED which are folded into the key hash, so upgrading model invalidated old cache — expected).
TTS_MODEL='tts-1-hd' and TTS_SPEED=0.94 wired to OpenAITextToSpeech.generate_speech — greeting audio ~non-trivial size, content-type audio/mpeg, no MongoDB _id leakage.
paymentSound.ts exposes VOICE_GREETINGS and previewVoice() correctly; per-character 'Tes' button in index.tsx wires to onTestVoice -> previewVoice(v, volume) without blocking UI.
CHAR_IMG static require() mapping is fine; all 4 asset files exist at /app/frontend/assets/characters/{lilis,parjo,bagas,putri}.png and load in the DOM.
Volume mapping vols=[Pelan=0.3, Sedang=0.6, Keras=1.0] matches spec; segment highlight uses tolerance |volume-o.v|<0.01 which is robust for float compare.
Default voice remains 'putri' via useState('putri') and storage.getItem fallback — verified by checkmark placement on Kak Putri on first mount.
Uses expo-audio (not deprecated expo-av). No deprecated Expo packages detected.
